combinations.magnitude: Jmjd1c-overexpression effect on PWT/NSF dramatically attenuated by Socs3 silencing
combinations.evidence_quote: As shown in Figure 6H, overexpression of Jmjd1c suppressed NP, as evidenced by elevated PWT and suppressed NSF, however, this effect was dramatically attenuated by co-treatment with injection of Socs3 silencing vectors.

combinations.magnitude: Socs3 overexpression reversed NP status promoted by Jmjd1c knockdown
combinations.evidence_quote: Consistently, enhanced Socs3 significantly reversed the promoted NP status caused by Jmjd1c knockdown (Fig. 6I).
